div.div: شُكْدٌ A gift: (S, L, K:) or a free gift: pl. أَشْكَادٌ. (L.) A recompense. (L.) [See شُكْمٌ in two places.] What is given of dates when they are cut, and of wheat when it is reaped. (L.) What is given of a heap of reaped corn on the occasion of the measuring, and of the bundles (حُزَم) [of corn] on the occasion of the reaping: of the dial. of El-Yemen. (L.) Travelling-provisions with which one is furnished, consisting of milk, or [the preparation of dried curd called] أَقِط, or clarified butter, or dates, and with which one goes forth from the abodes of a people. (L.) And Meat and drink deposited in a house or tent. (L.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
